purpose: Preregistration for the frozen fixed-model release (N08): the development set, the challenge set, the acceptance thresholds, and the exclusion list were fixed HERE, before any challenge render was inspected. The bundle itself (per-case model PCM sha256 vectors, block-level event traces, model identity, bundle hash) is built deterministically from this file by tools/n08_build_release.py into reference/release/manifest.json; expected oracle values are recorded only at the frozen challenge run (reference/release/challenge-results.json). Editing this file after the freeze invalidates the bundle (bundle hash + binding sha checks fail; all H-series conformance is STALE) and requires a new decision record plus a full re-freeze.
ordering_declaration: Thresholds and case selection in this file were committed before any challenge render was inspected. The challenge run consumes the thresholds from this file (tools/n08_challenge.py refuses to run unless thresholds_frozen_before_challenge is true and the binding hashes match) and records per-case verdicts at those frozen thresholds in reference/release/challenge-results.json in the same commit as this preregistration. Tuning thresholds after inspecting challenge failures is forbidden (plan section 7; issue #24 non-goals); a threshold change is a decision record plus a full re-freeze, never an in-place edit.
model_identity_note: The frozen model is the merged N06+N07 tree in this commit: src/gf180_dx7/sysex.py plus src/gf180_dx7/model/{__init__,operator,envelope,algorithm,pitch,tables,integrated,poly}.py, byte-unchanged from the N06/N07 merges. The bundle renders every case through the D00 polyphonic manager (src/gf180_dx7/model/poly.py) around the integrated single-note composition (src/gf180_dx7/model/integrated.py); the build additionally asserts byte-equality of the two layers on the single-note dev cases.

dev_set.definition: The N06-exact single-note registry set (docs/N06-INTEGRATED-MODEL.md section 4.2, 23 cases) plus the N07 wrapper-valid poly set (docs/N07-POLY-MODEL.md section 4, 4 registry cases + 3 dev32 velocity-contrast entries).
dev_set.dev32_note: dev32-03/06/30 are the velocity_contrast corpus entries proven EXACT at N07. Their voice bytes resolve from the pinned DX7_AllTheWeb archive (canonical-hash checked; bytes are never redistributed), so these three rows are archive-gated everywhere: the committed vectors are intact regardless, but re-rendering them in a fresh environment is guarded NOT_RUN unless the pinned archive is present. This is the declared environment boundary, never a silent pass.

challenge_set.definition: Preregistered registry cases NOT used for development, chosen for axis diversity to catch overfitting of the freeze process. Purely synthetic (all render from the registry synthetic_base), so the challenge is reproducible in any environment. Single-note only: the registry contains no fresh synthetic polyphonic case beyond the dev set; polyphonic challenge coverage is a recorded gap (see known_gaps).
challenge_set.selection_rationale: Axes: algorithms not in the dev registry set (5, 16, 31); oscillator fine frequency (bd-fine99); envelope timing shapes (delayed attack, rising segment, slow rate-3, nonzero final, fast release, rate scaling); LFO waveforms and delay with key-sync 1 determinacy (waves 1 and 5, delay 99, pitch-mod sensitivity); the amp-mod sensitivity path with a non-inert LFO (ampmod-ams3, the exact combination N06 declared NO_VERDICT); keyboard right-side scaling (kbd-right-c3); velocity sensitivity boundaries (kvs7 at velocity 30, kvs0 at velocity 127); pitch EG (peg-up); the repeated-note osc-key-sync phrase (osc-keysync0, pairs with the registry's observed-identical osc-keysync1); and the pinned-wrapper transpose finding (perf-transpose-12).

registry_cases.axis: amp-mod sensitivity 3 with non-inert LFO (N06 NO_VERDICT combination; strongest overfitting probe)
velocity 127 with velocity sensitivity 0 (identity partner vel-kvs0-30 in dev)
repeated-note phrase with osc key sync off (registry observed-identical partner osc-keysync1)
pinned-wrapper transpose finding (patch transpose ignored; bounded R06 finding)

excluded_cases.reason: Reference-side indeterminacy (N06 finding F-4 / R05): keysync 0 with the LFO reaching the PCM carries a C++-indeterminate LFO phase, so no derivable oracle value exists. The case is not oracle-comparable and is excluded from the bundle entirely; an owner ruling defining the reference behavior is a prerequisite for ever freezing it.

Documented policy divergence (N07): the model steals per D00 DEC-017 while the pinned wrapper drops the 17th note. No equality budget may be declared on this case; freezing a model-only vector would be legal but is excluded to keep every bundle row oracle-comparable or explicitly archived-gated-dev.
Registry BLOCKED: the pinned oracle grammar has no aftertouch event, so no executable reference render exists (R06 performance_controls status blocked; DEC-006 coverage tracked in R06).
Registry BLOCKED: the pinned oracle CC subset has no volume (CC 7) event (R06 performance_controls status blocked).
Registry BLOCKED at the oracle (single voice file per render); the D00 'patch <n>' event is model grammar only (DEC-019), so the case has no oracle-comparable reference.

Corpus-selector cases (archive-gated voice bytes). Excluded from the challenge set to keep the challenge reproducible in any environment; their axes (algorithms 4/6, high feedback) are already covered by dev and dev32 rows. Not a judgment about their value as future challenge material.

vector_conformance.applies: every bundle case: the committed vector file bytes, the model re-render at verification time, and any future RTL render (claim 1: RTL-vs-frozen-model must be EXACT; no numeric tolerance exists or is tolerated)
vector_conformance.event_trace_applies: the block-level event application log recorded per case must reproduce exactly at every verification

model_vs_oracle.applies: challenge rows with oracle_comparable=true, evaluated ONCE at the frozen challenge run (claim 2: model reproduces the pinned software reference). Any non-exact row is a bounded finding recorded in reference/release/challenge-results.json and the release notes at these frozen thresholds - it never retunes the threshold, never swaps the case, and never blocks the RTL-vs-model claim

verification_exit_codes.0: bundle intact and every performed check passes (NOT_RUN rows reported loudly, never as passes)
verification_exit_codes.1: tamper, drift, or a failed threshold; the failing case is named
verification_exit_codes.2: could not run (bundle/manifest missing or unreadable)

binding.note: sha256 of the exact inputs this preregistration was frozen against. The builder and verifier re-check these; any drift is STALE and requires a conscious re-freeze.

known_gaps: No polyphonic challenge case: the registry's polyphonic cases beyond the dev set are either the documented ev-steal-17 divergence or archive-gated corpus material; the challenge set is single-note. Polyphonic model semantics are covered by the dev set plus the N07 evidence, not by an independent challenge.
dev32-03/06/30 rows are archive-gated for re-rendering (voice bytes never redistributed); their committed vectors are environment-independent.

Amp-mod sensitivity with a non-inert LFO (ampmod-ams3) is deliberately in the challenge set despite the N06 NO_VERDICT flag: it is the strongest overfitting probe available. A failure there is a recorded bounded finding at the frozen thresholds, not a threshold change.
claims_boundary: This release freezes claim-1 material (the model is the exact RTL oracle) and records claim-2 evidence (model vs pinned software reference at frozen thresholds). It establishes nothing about original-DX7 fidelity, RTL conformance itself, synthesis, fit, or audibility (DEC-001, DEC-024, plan section 7).
